title: Boosting large scale capacitive harvesting of osmotic power by dynamic matching of ion exchange kinetics
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2087-2097
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01366B, Paper
Nicolas Chapuis, Lydéric Bocquet
Capacitive reversed electrodialysis is showcased as an effective osmotic energy recovery method, exceeding the power density break-even. Using capacitive electrodes, it alternates high and low salinity water flows across a large-scale membrane.
